speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Non, non. You make them speak French as an Englishman dreams it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Which words.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Two. I have mended them with my own pen. Beau, where she means the thing is well done. I have put bien over it. And sire, where she speaks to a woman. I have put madame.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Madame, then. I took the sound out of a yard. A yard is a bad French house.

speaker: richard_field
text: Let her keep the pen. She keeps the French and the sums. I keep the press.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The two strokes are enough. I will not argue a vowel with the woman who heard it.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: You may argue it. You will lose. The Princess's people are not Englishmen on a holiday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They are Englishmen in a play. I will take the mend. I will not take a third word I have not seen.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: There is no third. Two, and the pen is mine. Do not blot them on the way to the door.

speaker: richard_field
text: Thou'rt wasted on players. I say it as thy friend.

speaker: richard_field
text: Leave the book. I'll read it with the door shut.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: With the door shut. The princess would not survive the apprentices, and the apprentices have their catechism.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: If the door is shut, they stay at it. That is the arrangement. I am not giving them a play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard the friend in it. I am not leaving the company for a press. I am leaving the book.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: The cheese. The man who sold it swore Warwickshire. I have not been, so I will not swear.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It tastes of home, or of the way he said friend. I will not argue the crock against the word.

speaker: richard_field
text: It is the cheese. The court went down to Greenwich yesterday, my lord with it. Thou wilt have no summons before Michaelmas. I am not telling thee news.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard it last night. No summons is a clear week. I am not surprised, and I am not sorry.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Bring nothing back wet. Ink on my cloth is a bill, and I do write bills.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The book stays. I am taking the two words, because she wrote them where I can see the strokes.

speaker: richard_field
text: Before Tuesday. I know a book-keeper's patience, and I know when it ends.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Before Tuesday. Thursday is a duke and forty lines, and those are a part. They are not this leaf.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Then go before the cheese makes a patriot of you. Home vowels are a visit. They are not a lodging.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They are back. I can hear them. God keep thee, Richard.

speaker: richard_field
text: And thee. She has read the end. She mended two words. She did not mend the plot.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: The plot may stand. Two words are a correction. A plot is your business.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The plot may stand. I am for the close, and for a king who is not in this book.
